allow: PowerShell($so="$env:APPDATA\\Factorio\\script-output"; foreach\($f in @\("item-locale.json","recipe-locale.json","entity-locale.json","item-group-locale.json"\)\){ Write-Host "=== $f"; \(Get-Content "$so\\$f" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'customer|coin_to|entrance' } | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\) => $\($_.Value | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\)" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($d in @\('factorio-docs\\html','factorio-docs\\markdown'\)\) { if \(Test-Path $d\) { $m = Get-ChildItem $d -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; "{0}: {1:N2} MB \({2} files\)" -f $d, \($m.Sum/1MB\), $m.Count } else { "$d : not present" } })
PowerShell(try { $sh = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application; $sh.Windows\(\) | ForEach-Object { try { "$\($_.LocationURL\)" } catch {} } } catch { "COM failed: $_" })
PowerShell(foreach \($id in 27576,21392,25228,26932,21000\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop; "killed $id" } catch { "not running / failed: $id" } })
